//: The mod's typecheck (npm run typecheck): plugins/teamrig/hooks (register.ts and its spec) under the same strict flags as src/. Its imports of ../dist/*.js resolve to the source under src/ (rootDirs), so the mod is checked against the source types, not the built dist: node10 resolution, because Bundler and NodeNext look for .js in the same pass as .ts and find a built dist file before rootDirs reaches src/ (TypeScript 6 deprecates node10; revisit then). The engine's modules are typed by plugins/teamrig/typecheck. Not named tsconfig.json, and not inside the plugin, so the engine that runs the plugin never reads it.
